Message:
parport: Add support for the WCH382 2S/1P multi-IO card

WCH382 is a PCI-E card with 1 LPT and 2 DB9 COM ports detected as
Serial controller: Device 1c00:3250 (rev 10) (prog-if 05 [16850])
